profile.name: Umar Razzaq
profile.headline:
Building worlds.
Engineering experiences.
profile.intro: I build responsive gameplay, intelligent AI, and multiplayer experiences in Unreal Engine. From the first prototype to production-ready systems, I turn ambitious ideas into games that feel great to play.

about.heading:
A developer’s mindset.
A player’s curiosity.
about.body:
I’m an Unreal Engine developer specializing in C++ and Blueprint. My work spans AA and indie games, multiplayer frameworks, smart AI systems, real-time visualization, and tools that help teams create faster.

I enjoy the space where creative ambition meets technical problem-solving: making a mechanic feel responsive, giving AI purpose, or finding a cleaner way to build a complex system.

My goal is to deliver results that look great and perform reliably. I enjoy collaborating with teams to turn ambitious ideas into playable experiences.

services.title: Gameplay development
services.description: Expert implementation of character systems, combat mechanics, player interactions, and core gameplay features in Unreal Engine. I build responsive gameplay with clean C++ architecture and optimized Blueprint logic that scales with your project.

services.title: AI & behavior systems
services.description: Advanced AI development using Behavior Trees, EQS, State Trees, and perception systems to create intelligent, adaptive NPCs. From enemy combat behaviors to companion logic, I design AI that responds naturally to player actions.

services.title: Multiplayer systems
services.description: Robust networking solutions with replication, authority management, and lag compensation. I build online experiences that handle client-server communication reliably across different network conditions.

services.title: Tools & plugins
services.description: Custom editor tools, automation scripts, and workflow-enhancing plugins built in C++ and Python. These solutions streamline development pipelines and reduce repetitive work in Unreal Engine.

services.title: Performance optimization
services.description: Profiling and optimization to improve frame rates and reduce overhead. I identify bottlenecks in rendering and gameplay code so projects run smoothly across target platforms.

services.title: UI & interactive experiences
services.description: Interactive, responsive UMG interfaces built with Blueprint. I craft menu systems, HUD elements, and in-game UI that scales across screen sizes and complements a game?s style.

contact.heading: Let’s build something worth playing.
contact.intro: Have a project in mind, need help with a technical challenge, or want to talk games? I’d love to hear from you.
